label: SIMULATION / HISTORICAL REPLAY — NOT PAID WORK
title: Memory leak when using abort signals
issueBody: We have encountered a memory leak issue. After an extensive search for the source of the leak, it was found that it occurred in pMap. Upon reviewing the source code of your package, I discovered that you subscribe to the AbortSignal event but do not unsubscribe from it, which causes the memory leak.
expectedDeliverable: Resolve the original issue with focused regression evidence and a professional unpublished PR draft.
antiLeakage: Use only this packet and the supplied pre-fix repository. No upstream lookup, remote git, accepted fixes, post-fix source or discussions. Ground truth is withheld until independent QA is frozen.
